item.title: New Epstein docs reveal 'nauseating' details about Trump's next Fed pick: GOP analyst
item.description: The new Jeffrey Epstein files released on Friday include "nauseating" details about President Donald Trump's pick to lead the Federal Reserve, according to one GOP analyst. item.description: Mockery abounded on Sunday night after President Donald Trump announced that the embattled Kennedy Center would close for two years as a wave of performers cancelled their dates.
